title: Lower weight decay for short training budget (WEIGHT_DECAY 0.2 -> 0.1)
description: Halved WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.2 to 0.1, all else unchanged from DEPTH=10 baseline.
reflection: val_bpb 1.003496, slightly worse than baseline 1.002279. Weight decay is not the lever: neither this halving nor (implicitly) the current 0.2 default seem to be the bottleneck. Five rounds now (depth up/down, matrix_lr up/down, warmdown length, weight decay down) have all failed to beat the DEPTH=10 baseline, suggesting the current hyperparameter configuration sits in a fairly robust local optimum for single-axis perturbations. Future rounds should consider a genuinely different lever (e.g. architecture changes like window pattern, MLP ratio, or embedding LR) rather than another one-off LR/regularization tweak, or accept that this baseline may be close to the practical ceiling for this time budget.
